scope: Shared version-aware scalar validation enforces valid SwapEffect enums and one normalized buffer for COPY, plus COPY_VSYNC for D3D8, at CreateDevice/Reset/CreateAdditionalSwapChain. Invalid calls fail before allocation or emission, initialize object outputs to NULL and leave caller parameters unchanged; failed Reset preserves the live graph but publishes the required lost/reset status, and valid Reset recovers. D3D8 effect 4 remains valid; effect 4/5 is invalid for the non-Ex D3D9 implementation. Existing DISCARD/FLIP count 2/3 acceptance is preserved, while actual multiple-buffer storage/rotation remains unimplemented. Native guards cover windowed/fullscreen parameter validation without invoking window work; XP covers windowed behavior only. Full MSAA/quality/flags/refresh constraints, multiple buffers, complete Reset/thread/device loss, original Microsoft HAL, game/FPS acceptance and review stages 4/5/6 remain incomplete. This phase has no draw or successful Present command and no new GPU pixel run; host/protocol/shader/bundle unchanged, inherit the accepted GPU baselines.
